_comment: Copied to <project-root>/<project>/first-users-hunter/config.json on first run. Replace placeholders; never commit a real config to the agent folder. founder.handles: your own public handles (excluded from results, counted for Confidence). icp_keywords: words a matching signal must contain. recency_days: max signal age per type (ask, switch, complaint, question, trigger, event, build), overriding assets/criteria.json. activity: overrides of the activity gate (window_days, min_weighted_posts...). sources: one block per collector, see scripts/collectors/<name>.py --help. Reddit needs a free script app (REDDIT_CLIENT_ID, REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET in the environment); GitHub discussions need a free GITHUB_TOKEN; every other source needs no key. Optional: a "tools" object (same keys as shared/tools.example.json) overrides the project's tool choices for this agent.
idea: <one paragraph: what the product does and what problem it solves>
target_user: <who is the early adopter: role, stage or vertical, size, place>

queries.query: <phrase written when the need is live>
